subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What default chat-visible policy should OpenClaw use for tool failure reasons and same-turn retry recovery across trusted operator chats and external-recipient channels?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but the safe behavior depends on maintainer intent for redaction, channel trust, operator noise, and duplicate-side-effect risk.

options.title: Adopt Safe Summaries
options.body: Show allowlisted or redacted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final status when the same failed action is later resolved, backed by compact, verbose, and channel tests.

options.title: Keep Compact Defaults
options.body: Keep ordinary compact warnings reason-free by default and rely on verbose mode or explicit suppression settings for operators who prefer different privacy and noise tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer To Native Recovery
options.body: Treat this issue as dependent on the broader native tool-recovery design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85914 before changing warning semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt Safe Summaries
recommendation.body: Show allowlisted or redacted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final status when the same failed action is later resolved, backed by compact, verbose, and channel tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily a core chat security/product policy choice, and steipete is the strongest current-main routing signal on the affected files.
